# disks

Virtual disks provide the block storage an instance boots from and writes to.

## GET /v1/disks

Operation `disk_list`.

`GET /v1/disks?tenant=&project=&instance=`. Flat disk list. AP-2e requires `?instance=<uuid>`; cross-project disk searches arrive when the customer surface needs them.

Paginated per convention 3: `limit` (default 50, capped at 500), `page_token`, and `sort_by`. Only `id_ascending` is accepted, because `disk/in_instance/` is keyed by the disk id.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to disks attached to a single instance. Backed by the existing `disk/in_instance/<instance>/<disk>` membership index. |
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ResultsPage_for_DiskView](schemas.md#resultspage_for_diskview)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/disks/{disk_id}/resize

Operation `disk_resize`.

`POST /v1/disks/{disk_id}/resize`. Grow a disk's backing volume. Grow-only: a size at or below the current size is rejected.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `disk_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

## GET /v1/instances/{instance_id}/disks

Operation `instance_disk_list`.

Every disk attached to one instance. The nested spelling of `GET /v1/disks?instance=<uuid>`, and the discoverable one: the instance is a path segment, so there is no selector to omit and no `400 MissingScope` on the common path.

Paginated per convention 3: `limit` (default 50, capped at 500), `page_token`, and `sort_by`. Only `id_ascending` is accepted, because `disk/in_instance/` is keyed by the disk id.

Cursors are not interchangeable with the flat collection's even though both walk that index: the two bind different endpoint identities, so a token cannot cross between them when their selectors diverge under convention 4.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ResultsPage_for_DiskView](schemas.md#resultspage_for_diskview)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
